title: Never underestimate a station wagon full of tapes
body: Andrew Tanenbaum's classic line observes that a vehicle full of storage media hurtling down a highway has staggering bandwidth and atrocious latency. It remains true: trucks of drives beat networks for exabyte moves while losing on any interactive measure. Throughput and latency are different goods, and bulk data still sometimes travels by road, now as AWS Snowball-style appliances.
